The regional standard specifies at least 15 sqm of net useful area exclusively dedicated to children; this is a room-level requirement and cannot be inferred from the gross property area. Verify the applicable rules at the application date, the dedicated room and domestic facilities, and all planning, building, health, accessibility, safety, and authorization checks.
pros: Reported area of 1,226.68 sqm is above the user's 95 sqm gross-area requirement.
A4 energy class is better than the preferred C threshold; the building dates from 2020.
Green-space proximity percentile is high at 94.26, with strong reported access to healthcare, mobility, commercial services, and education.
cons: The data do not verify capacity for four people or the required 15 sqm net useful area exclusively dedicated to children.
Urban-planning compatibility, building title or change of use, hygiene, accessibility, safety, and sector authorization all require verification.
The regulatory context lists domestic conditions including a kitchen, bathroom, and outdoor space, none of which are confirmed by the property data.

evaluation_results.evaluation_text: With a reported gross area of 254.46 sqm, this residential property is well above the requested 95 sqm threshold, and its energy class C meets the stated preference. Its strong green-space proximity score (91.35) is also favorable. These attributes support further consideration for a home-based nursery, but they do not establish that the dwelling can accommodate the required dedicated child space or four people. The verified regional standard specifies at least 5 sqm of net useful area per child and a separate minimum of 15 sqm net useful area for the exclusively dedicated children’s environment; neither is comparable to the property’s gross area. The kitchen, bathroom and outdoor-space conditions, room layout, and applicable authorization and planning requirements all need verification.
pros: Reported gross area of 254.46 sqm exceeds the user's 95 sqm requirement.
Energy class C meets the user's stated preference.
Green-space proximity score of 91.35 aligns with the preference for nearby green space.
cons: The large gross area does not verify the required net useful area or a suitable exclusively dedicated children’s environment.
Kitchen, bathroom, outdoor-space conditions, room layout and four-person capacity are not established by the supplied data.
Turin planning compatibility, applicable authorization, and other required safety, hygiene and accessibility checks remain to be verified.
